## Description

The array of all support heroes in Overwatch. The order is currently as follows:
        
        0. Mercy
        1. Zenyatta
        2. Lúcio
        3. Ana
        4. Brigitte
        5. Moira
        6. Baptiste
				7. Kiriko
				8. Lifeweaver
				9. Illari
				10. Juno
				11. Wuyang
